name: Skull Cap Trend AI: Put On the Skull Cap, Become the Chad
blurb: The skull cap trend is the TikTok glow-up of October 2026: someone looks plain and goofy, the beat drops, and they come back in a black skull cap with the hood up and an intense stare, as if the cap turned them into a Chad.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 11 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a phone selfie video of one young adult at a desk, the same framing, camera angle, timing, moves and light change. The ONLY change: the man with curly dark hair, clear glasses and a thin moustache is now the person in [Image 1]. The same person, plain and shy, then on the cut a sharp, confident version with an intense stare at the camera and moody light.

The person = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame of both parts: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends recognize them at once, also in the dark second part and under the hood. Never morph, never drift back to the original man's face. NO curly dark hair, NO thin moustache, NO goatee and NO arm tattoos unless [Image 1] shows them, and the age of [Image 1]. Glasses only in the first part and only if [Image 1] shows glasses; never glasses in the second part. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the person is that animal sitting upright at the desk, with its own face, fur and markings and the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything.

PART 1, THE BEFORE (00:00-00:04.4): a bright room with the ceiling light on. The person wears the clothes from [Image 1] (if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, a plain T-shirt) and their own hair from [Image 1], uncovered, no cap, no hood.
00:00-00:00.5: looks into the camera with a plain, slightly awkward face.
00:00.5-00:03: runs both hands through the hair and holds the head, a goofy, pouty face, eyebrows up.
00:03-00:04.4: lowers the hands, a silly hand gesture, then reaches toward the camera.
00:04.4-00:05: the hand sweeps over the lens, a fast blur: the cut on the beat drop.

PART 2, THE AFTER (00:05-00:11): the same desk, now dark, dim cool light from a window behind, deep shadows. The person always wears a plain black hoodie with the hood up over a tight black skull cap low on the forehead that covers all the hair, and a thin silver chain, never the clothes from [Image 1]. No glasses.
00:05-00:06: leans in from low in the frame and looks up into the camera.
00:06-00:08.5: a slow, cool head tilt, one hand adjusts the hood by the temple, a hand passes close to the lens.
00:08.5-00:09: turns the head to the side, then back.
00:09-00:11: forearms on the desk, chin up, a cold, confident, half-lidded stare straight into the camera, lips closed.

FACIAL EXPRESSION: goofy and awkward in part 1, intense, serious and confident in part 2, never smiling in part 2.

Real live-action phone footage, clear facial features. Avoid: text, captions, logos, watermarks, extra people, morphing.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the person's shoulders. Two arms and two hands, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person in the frame.
